A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same study, with 41 readable pages including Appendices A–C. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to the arXiv stamp and Figure 1 caption.

before.justification: v1 reports original molecular-generation experiments, baseline comparisons, ablations, surrogate evaluations, and molecular simulations in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–2, molecular simulations in Figure 4, and supplementary results in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The diffusion backbone, surrogate models, rewards, and policy updates are unchanged. Removing c from the forward-noising expression in Figure 1's caption aligns it with the existing diagram and Appendix A.1; it does not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use QM9, ZINC15, and PubChem, retain EGFR-focused molecular evaluation, and include the same additional QM9 property groups in Table C.4.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical throughout, including SFT-PG, DDPO-SF, DDPO-IS, and DPOK in Tables 1 and C.2; optimization alternatives in Table 2; and TFG, Best-of-N, SMC, PILOT, and DiffSMol in Table C.3.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain identical splits, preprocessing, metrics, hyperparameters, simulation settings, and the generation of 2,000 molecules per evaluation run.

E4.justification: The component ablations, property-correlation analysis, surrogate diagnostics, molecular case studies, and free-energy analysis are unchanged in Table 2, Figure 4, and Appendix C.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same three independent evaluation runs and mean ± 95% confidence intervals. No statistical reporting or uncertainty-estimation procedure changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are identical, including Tables 1–2 and C.1–C.6. For example, Table 1 retains the proposed method's QM9 validity of 98.17 ± 0.07%.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, and derivations remain unchanged. The caption edit from q(z_t | z_{t-1}, c) to q(z_t | z_{t-1}) restates the forward kernel already defined in Appendix A.1, Equation (A.4), rather than revising the mathematical formulation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain identical claims about uncertainty-aware multi-objective RL, molecular quality, architectural generality, and drug-discovery potential.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and limitations are identical, including the attribution of PubChem difficulties to backbone scalability and Appendix C.1's qualification concerning independence when optimizing more properties.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same implementation details, hyperparameter tables, hardware, timing information, and data-access instructions. Code-access statements are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and references [1]–[69] are identical; no cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes, and Figure 1 receives a localized notation edit. Prose, terminology, section ordering, and appendix structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption removes c from the forward-noising expression, slightly changing its line wrapping. The diagram itself and every other figure and table are unchanged; the first-page arXiv stamp also updates.

improvement.justification: The caption edit improves local consistency with Figure 1's diagram and Equation (A.4), but the forward process was already specified there. This small clarification leaves the paper's scientific explanation, empirical support, reproducibility information, and limitations effectively unchanged, without a meaningful overall quality difference.
